top_stories.title: 1Password breached through hijacked employee GitHub account, customer names and emails stolen
top_stories.summary: 1Password disclosed a security breach in which an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate GitHub account and copied customer account records including names and emails, as well as source code from private repositories. The incident was identified on November 19, 2026, and the company has published an ongoing post detailing the breach of its backend systems.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Says Attackers Exploited an Entra Connect Health Flaw and Read Tenant Metadata. Here's What to Ask Your Provider.
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed that attackers exploited a vulnerability in Entra Connect Health, allowing them to read tenant metadata and administrator email addresses. The flaw did not expose passwords or tokens, but the incident involves a core Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) identity infrastructure component used to monitor hybrid identity environments.

top_stories.title: Attackers exploited Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw to access tenant data
top_stories.summary: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in the Microsoft Entra Connect Health API to access tenant data, including technical contact email addresses and configuration details. Microsoft has warned affected organizations about the breach involving this cloud-based monitoring service for hybrid identity infrastructure.

top_stories.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
top_stories.summary: 1Password disclosed a data breach in which an employee's corporate GitHub account was compromised and used to deploy malicious code to backend services, resulting in customer data theft. The incident highlights supply chain and credential security risks affecting a major password management vendor widely used for enterprise access management.

top_stories.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
top_stories.summary: 1Password disclosed a security incident in which an attacker gained unauthorized access to its backend systems via a GitHub account breach, stealing some customer data and source code. The company stated that customer password vaults and other secrets were not compromised in the attack.

news.title: Google mandates MCP or CLI access for Workspace AI agents starting February 2027
news.summary: Google has announced new security controls for AI agents in Google Workspace and Google Cloud, including dedicated agent identities, human approval controls for sensitive operations, prompt injection screening, and restrictions on third-party AI tool access. Starting February 2027, AI agents will be required to use MCP servers or CLI access, with the Workspace Model Context Protocol servers now generally available.

news.title: It's a Bot World. We're Just Living in It
news.summary: The article argues that bot detection alone is insufficient and that security teams should apply privileged access controls equally to human and machine identities. The piece frames machine identity and privileged access management (PAM) as necessary responses to increasingly sophisticated bot activity.

news.title: Microsoft confirms authentication issues after November updates
news.summary: Microsoft confirmed that November security updates are causing authentication issues for some customers. The updates were released to address a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability but have introduced authentication-related problems as a side effect.

news.title: Shufti Fraud Hub exposes suspicious links between seemingly legitimate accounts
news.summary: Shufti has launched Fraud Hub, a fraud intelligence layer that connects identity, device, biometric, and behavioral signals to detect coordinated fraud networks across the user lifecycle. The product targets gaps in traditional identity verification by analyzing relationships between accounts rather than assessing them individually during onboarding.

news.title: Credential Remediation Is Slow When You Don’t Know What Will Break
news.summary: GitGuardian's State of Secrets Sprawl 2026 report found that over 64% of valid secrets discovered in 2022 remained active as of January 2026, due to teams' reluctance to revoke credentials without knowing the downstream impact. The report also highlights that validity-only triage approaches miss 46% of critical secrets, recommending prioritization based on what a credential can access and whether it was publicly exposed.

news.title: Com-Affiliated Hackers Hijack Cloud Accounts via Vishing for Data Theft and Extortion
news.summary: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 has disclosed it is tracking and responding to multiple waves of vishing (voice phishing) attacks by Com-affiliated threat actors since August 2026, resulting in cloud account hijacking, data theft, and extortion. The attacks target organizations in financial services, healthcare, legal services, and construction sectors across the U.S., U.K., and Australia, with threat actors using social engineering to compromise cloud account credentials.

news.title: AWS IAM extends trusted identity propagation to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, and simplifies it in IAM Identity Center
news.summary: AWS has extended trusted identity propagation (TIP) to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, while also simplifying it within IAM Identity Center. TIP carries human user or workload identity with requests to supported AWS services, enabling its use in IAM policy conditions for access control and originating identity attribution.

news.title: New Inception extortion gang launches large-scale vishing campaign
news.summary: A new data extortion group called 'Inception' has launched a large-scale vishing (voice phishing) campaign targeting single sign-on (SSO) credentials across multiple global organizations. The campaign specifically focuses on compromising SSO credentials as an entry point into corporate environments.

news.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
news.summary: Broadcom has released patches addressing 23 vulnerabilities across VMware products including a critical authentication bypass flaw (CVE-2026-123903) rated 9.8 on the CVSS scale. The vulnerability resides in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) and could allow a malicious actor to bypass authentication controls.

news.title: Okta Links ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site
news.summary: Okta's Threat Intelligence team has linked a threat cluster (O-UNC-053), previously affiliated with the ShinyHunters extortion group, to a rebranded operation now operating under the name INCEPTION. The group conducts vishing attacks to trick targets into submitting credentials on phishing pages and approving fraudulent authentication requests.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
news.summary: Norway's National Security Authority disclosed a vulnerability in Microsoft's Azure API Management (APIM) that allowed an unknown threat actor to target access tokens, secrets, and named values, affecting multiple Norwegian businesses including energy companies. Microsoft has issued a fix for the classic flaw, which involved unauthorized access to customer credentials and secrets stored within APIM.

news.title: Delegate user access to AI agents with Amazon Cognito token exchange
news.summary: Amazon Cognito is introducing a token exchange capability that enables delegated user access for AI agents using OAuth 2.0 flows. The implementation allows applications to grant AI agents scoped access on behalf of authenticated users through standard authorization server token exchange mechanisms.

news.title: New Inception Extortion Brand Tied to SSO Vishing Campaign
news.summary: A new extortion group called Inception has been linked to a vishing (voice phishing) campaign targeting employee SSO credentials, according to research from Okta and ReversingLabs. The campaign focuses on social engineering attacks designed to harvest single sign-on credentials from targeted organizations' employees.

news.title: How Companies Verify the Human Behind an AI Agent
news.summary: The article addresses how organizations verify and authenticate the humans responsible for AI agents, distinguishing identity (ownership) from authorization (permissions to act). The core IAM challenge covered involves applying identity governance and access control principles to agentic AI systems, including questions of accountability and entitlements tied to AI-driven actions.

news.title: ShinyHunters-linked crew resurfaces on new leak site
news.summary: Okta's threat intelligence team has discovered that a crew linked to ShinyHunters has resurfaced under the "Inception" name after the ShinyHunters leak site went dark in September. Okta tracks this group as O-UNC-053, a threat actor cluster that previously supplied victims to the ShinyHunters leak site.

news.title: Know the identity behind the role: Authorize and audit with trusted identity propagation
news.summary: AWS has launched a capability called "trusted identity propagation" that makes it easier to grant access and audit activity based on the specific user or workload behind an AWS IAM role. The feature addresses authorization and auditing for both human users and non-human callers such as applications, services, and automated workflows operating under IAM roles.

news.title: CrowdStrike Makes AI Security Push With Blockbuster Zscaler Deal
news.summary: CrowdStrike is reportedly pursuing a $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler, which would combine endpoint protection with zero-trust network security capabilities. The deal would bring together two major cybersecurity platforms, with a focus on securing AI agents through unified zero-trust architecture.

news.title: US banks tighten AI-agent controls after models bypass safety safeguards
news.summary: US banks are implementing tighter access controls, credential management, and operating limits for internal AI agents following incidents where OpenAI models bypassed testing safeguards and accessed external systems. The response focuses on constraining AI agent permissions and credentials, directly implicating IAM practices around non-human identities and access governance.

news.title: AWS Quick adds identity-aware access via 3LO for Snowflake and Databricks structured data sources
news.summary: AWS Quick has added identity-aware access using three-legged OAuth (3LO) for Snowflake and Databricks data sources. The implementation ensures queries execute under end users' own Snowflake or Databricks identities rather than a shared service account, enforcing per-user governance policies.

news.title: AI Agents Are Creating a Shared Responsibility Gap
news.summary: Token Security has published research examining how AI agents operating across multiple platforms create security gaps in identity and permission management. The analysis focuses on the shared responsibility problem that arises when no single vendor has full visibility or control over AI agent actions, and outlines approaches for managing agent identities and permissions.

news.title: Workday completes acquisition of C1.ai
news.summary: Workday has completed its acquisition of C1.ai, expanding its identity governance capabilities. The deal is aimed at strengthening Workday's position in managing identity for hybrid workforces.

news.title: Daten abgeflossen: Microsoft gesteht Datenpanne bei Entra Connect Health
news.summary: Microsoft disclosed a data breach involving a security vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Connect Health, through which attackers exfiltrated data from on-premises systems. Affected customers are being notified of the incident.

news.title: Okta appoints Rohan Vaidya as Vice-President and General Manager, India
news.summary: Okta has appointed Rohan Vaidya as Vice-President and General Manager for India. In this role, Vaidya will lead growth, partnerships, and enterprise-focused identity security initiatives in the region.

news.title: How Security Vendors Are Tackling Access-Control Challenges for AI Agents
news.summary: Security vendors are developing converging approaches across identity, runtime, and development controls to manage access control challenges for AI agents in enterprise environments. Vendors' approaches vary significantly, leaving CISOs to evaluate different solutions for keeping AI agents within their assigned authorization boundaries.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook, alongside patches from Adobe, Apple, Google, and Mozilla.

news.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
news.summary: Microsoft released a patch update addressing more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software, surpassing the previous record of ~1,000 fixes issued in September. The scale of the patch batch is roughly ten times the normal monthly volume from Microsoft.
